mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 2% over the previous 3 months, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tight monetary policy combined with a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous 3 months, it signals strong economic growth and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months
regime_hint: strong economic growth with tightening labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 grows by more than 2% QoQ and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.
